description: A serial-in parallel-out shift register: each trigger samples the input into a register of 4096 cells, and sixteen output channels read back cells picked by SKIP and INCR.

params.text: Sets how far back in the register output channel 1 reads, 0 to 127 cells; at 0 the module behaves as a plain shift register.
Sets how many further cells back each output channel reads than the channel before it, 0 to 7; at 0 every channel reads the same spacing as a plain shift register.

inputs.text: The monophonic signal sampled into the register.
A trigger samples the input signal and stores it in the next cell of the register.
Adds to the number of cells output channel 1 reads back, 0-10V mapping onto 0 to 127 cells.
Adds to the spacing between output channels, 0-10V mapping onto 0 to 7 cells.

outputs.text: Sixteen channels carrying the register cells picked out by SKIP and INCR.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
